instruction: Two metadata fixes for the qamstack pages. First, neither qamstack/index.html nor qamstack/quality-harness/index.html declares an og:image or twitter:image, so their twitter:card should be "summary", not "summary_large_image": change it on both pages. Second, AI Agent Memory is also a hosted service reached from the browser, so in the JSON-LD of qamstack/index.html, the AI Agent Memory SoftwareApplication's operatingSystem becomes "macOS, Linux, Windows, Web". The other two tools in that JSON-LD (Quality Harness and MultiPath Read/Write) and the Quality Harness page's own JSON-LD keep "macOS, Linux, Windows". Change nothing else.
